EmailTemplate.description: Approval request sent by the Opportunity discount approval process itself (its emailTemplate element, M3-S02) to the assigned approver - the opportunity owner's manager. Not driven by a workflow alert, so it has no sender of its own: the approval engine sends it.
EmailTemplate.name: Discount Approval Request
EmailTemplate.subject: Discount approval needed: {!Opportunity.Name} at {!Opportunity.Discount__c}
